causal_macro_target.native_discovery: median price of lawful positive-size true prints in [first lawful print, first lawful print + 60 minutes)
causal_macro_target.availability: only after the complete discovery interval has elapsed
causal_macro_target.challenger_target: frozen discovery price minus the native ATLAS_V1 page bottom.depth_p50
causal_macro_target.mains_target: PAR_LOCK_JOIN at the first lawful external bid; no deep aim
causal_macro_target.page_key: category|native ATLAS leader-or-underdog key|native discovery price bucket
causal_macro_target.recut_cell_contract: recut_cells is close-keyed and remains NO_CALL for decision targeting when a causal own-close projection is unavailable

other_historical_surface_contract.drift_surfaces_v1: NO_CALL when the native fitted band requires future net/dip components
other_historical_surface_contract.band_map_v1: NO_CALL when the native category band requires future net/dip components
other_historical_surface_contract.divot_tables_v1: the band-keyed historical table is NO_CALL without a causal fitted band; receipt-identifiable chronological divots remain independently bound
other_historical_surface_contract.LIBRARY_V1: NO_CALL for action timing because its own metadata marks the -0k timing axis mis-anchored
other_historical_surface_contract.ORIENT_V1: NO_CALL without a separately frozen causal pair-tell consumer

causal_macro_target.missing_behavior: MACRO_TARGET_NO_CALL; D continues and lawful BBO join-presence remains

common_order_law.pair_presence: both legs join the first coherent lawful positive-size external BBO pair read
common_order_law.target_expression: after every adjustment: target at or below non-self bid rests at target; target above bid expresses at exactly bid+1; final price must be below ask and inside 1..99
candidate_A_revisions: one initial downward macro target adoption

price_fillability_contract.PRICE_REACHED: a receipt-identified positive-size non-self public execution occurs at or below the exposed buy limit
price_fillability_contract.CERTAIN_FILL: a public execution occurs strictly below the limit or the lawful external ask moves strictly below the limit
price_fillability_contract.EXACT_TOUCH: a public execution or lawful external ask reaches the limit exactly
price_fillability_contract.accounting_after_fillability: once PRICE_REACHED, assign exactly five simulated shares at the exposed limit for later C/PC accounting
price_fillability_contract.queue_and_depth_role: decision input and stress diagnostic only; never a primary fillability gate
price_fillability_contract.cumulative_five_counterfactual: reported only as a false-negative diagnostic

liveaim_contract.executed_share_volume_and_cadence: stored on every state receipt and stress grade; no unsourced standalone direction gate

divot_contract.action: confirm and hold the already selected target; re-expose only when the same target lacks an order and lawful BBO authority returns

combined_headroom_contract.first_fill: first PRICE_REACHED leg is assigned exactly five shares at its exposed limit
combined_headroom_contract.d1: first_leg_limit_price minus contemporaneous first-leg non-self external bid
combined_headroom_contract.later_trigger: strictly later receipt-identified positive-size non-self sibling public execution
combined_headroom_contract.movement: at most one +1-cent sibling improvement per lawful trigger
combined_headroom_contract.d2: fully expressed proposed sibling limit minus contemporaneous sibling non-self external bid
